title: Pure Blue-Eyes
summary: Blue-Eyes monsters and the Eyes of Blue engine built around Blue-Eyes White Dragon, with generic staples. Powered by the 2025 support wave (Maiden of White, Wishes for Eyes of Blue, Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons, Neo Kaiser Sea Horse, and Spirit with Eyes of Blue), the deck swarms Level 8 Dragons and Level 1 LIGHT Tuners into Level 9 and Level 12 Dragon Synchros and Fusions.

summary.title: Starters
points: Sage with Eyes of Blue searches any Level 1 LIGHT Tuner on Normal Summon (Maiden of White, The White Stone of Ancients, or The White Stone of Legend), and discards itself to send an Effect Monster you control to the GY and Special Summon a Blue-Eyes monster from the Deck.

Wishes for Eyes of Blue discards 1 card to add both 1 Level 1 LIGHT Tuner and 1 Spell/Trap that mentions Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the hand, and banishes itself from the GY to equip a Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon from the Extra Deck to Blue-Eyes White Dragon.

Maiden of White sends itself from the hand or field to the GY to place True Light face-up from the hand, Deck, or GY, and Special Summons itself from the GY whenever you Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon.

Neo Kaiser Sea Horse Special Summons itself from the hand while you control Blue-Eyes White Dragon, adjusts Level 4 or lower LIGHT Tuners' Levels by 1, and sends a Blue-Eyes monster or card that mentions Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the Deck to the GY when sent from the field to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Sage with Eyes of Blue (1-Card Line)
steps: Normal Summon Sage with Eyes of Blue and search Maiden of White; discard Maiden of White to place True Light face-up on the field.

Link Summon Spirit with Eyes of Blue using Sage to search Mausoleum of White, then Tribute Spirit with Eyes of Blue (or activate True Light) to Special Summon Blue-Eyes White Dragon from the hand or GY, triggering Maiden of White to revive itself from the GY.

Use True Light to Set Wishes for Eyes of Blue or Majesty of the White Dragons, then Synchro Summon Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon (Level 9), or use Mausoleum of White's extra Normal Summon and Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons to put a second Tuner on the field for Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon (Level 12).

summary.title: Dragon Lock & Crimson Dragon Tag-Out
summary.text: Spirit with Eyes of Blue and Roar of the Blue-Eyed Dragons lock your Special Summons from the Extra Deck to Dragon monsters while active or for the turn, so the entire Extra Deck is pure Dragon. Blue-Eyes Spirit Dragon negates GY activations and blocks Pendulum/multi-summons, then Tributes itself as a Quick Effect to summon Crimson Dragon or Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon; with a second Level 9 or 12 Synchro on the field, Crimson Dragon tags out into another Level 9 or 12 Dragon Synchro on the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Blue-Eyes Ultimate Spirit Dragon prevents the opponent from banishing cards from your GY, negates any card or effect activated on the field once per turn while gaining 1000 ATK, and revives a LIGHT Dragon from the GY when destroyed.

Dragon Master Magia (fused via Ultimate Fusion using Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon equipped by Wishes for Eyes of Blue and Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon) negates up to 1 Monster, 1 Spell, and 1 Trap activation each turn.

Blue-Eyes Jet Dragon protects all other cards you control from targeting and card-effect destruction, bounces an opposing card when battling, and revives itself whenever any card on the field is destroyed.

Majesty of the White Dragons reveals up to 3 Blue-Eyes White Dragons in your hand, field, and/or GY to destroy that many cards the opponent controls, and banishes itself from the GY to Ritual Summon Blue-Eyes Chaos MAX Dragon.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's combo lines include a Dracoverlord Ritual engine and Deep-Eyes White Dragon (which is not yet released in the TCG), so those external cards are omitted in favor of the pure Blue-Eyes core.
